row.team_price_text: Scaling: $8/u/mo billed yearly ($10 monthly), 10 user minimum
row.evidence: Tettra's pricing table lists User provisioning (SCIM) as a 'Paid add-on' on Scaling and 'Included' on Enterprise (Custom pricing).
row.notes: New row. Scaling is $8/user/mo billed yearly ($10 monthly) with a 10-user minimum; Enterprise is custom pricing with 'SSO & SCIM included'. SAML SSO and SCIM are each a paid add-on on Scaling with no published price, so status is gated. SCIM runs through WorkOS directory sync, set up by Tettra support; no Tettra-hosted SCIM base URL is published, so idp values are via_generic and generic is null. Help-centre articles still call the SSO/SCIM tier 'Professional' (an older plan name); the API overview names Scaling and Enterprise. SSO is required before SCIM. Group sync drives invite-only category permissions; roles cannot be mapped from groups. Public API is limited to pages, page requests, search and questions (no user management). Google and Slack sign-in on all plans does not count as SSO.

plans.name: Scaling
plans.price_text: $8 per user/month billed yearly ($10 billed monthly), 10 user minimum
plans.notes: SAML SSO and SCIM are each a 'Paid add-on' (price not listed). API keys available, but the API has no user endpoints. Monthly price $10 from the page's billing toggle script.

roles.how: Not possible to assign roles from directory groups; all SCIM-created users get the team's default role.

limitations.text: SSO must be set up before SCIM.
SSO/SCIM only works with non-public email domains (not Gmail, Yahoo, Outlook).
Roles cannot be assigned from directory groups; new users get the default role.
Setup runs through WorkOS and requires contacting Tettra; the customer must keep WorkOS access.

scim.notes: Delivered through WorkOS Directory Sync. Tettra enables SSO, then emails WorkOS setup instructions; SCIM sync is switched on in Admin settings. No Tettra SCIM base URL, token or SCIM version is published.

limitations.text: The API is still experimental and limited to pages, page requests, search and questions.

user_api.notes: Tettra has a limited, experimental public API (Scaling and Enterprise) for pages, page requests, search and questions. No user, group or role endpoints are documented.

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/tettra/ returned 404; Tettra's SSO overview lists Okta (via WorkOS).

entra.notes: No Learn tutorial at saas-apps/tettra-tutorial (404); Tettra lists Azure AD (via WorkOS).

google.notes: No Google catalogue entry checked; Tettra lists Google SAML (via WorkOS) and has a separate Google Workspace integration for group permissions.

onelogin.notes: OneLogin connector page not checked (bot wall); Tettra lists OneLogin (via WorkOS).

jumpcloud.notes: jumpcloud.com/integrations/tettra returned 404; Tettra lists JumpCloud (via WorkOS).

fallbacks.other_sync: Google Workspace integration (Google Groups permissions, legacy; disabled when SCIM sync is on)
fallbacks.notes: With SSO on, users on verified domains can join without an invitation. Bulk invite by comma-separated emails; no CSV import documented.
